wikibasefacetedsearch-description: Enhances [[Special:Search]] with faceted search capabilities. Filter results based on instance type or statement values
wikibase-faceted-search-config-invalid: Your changes were not saved. They contain the following {{PLURAL:$1|error|errors}}:
wikibase-faceted-search-config-help-docu: You can [[#ConfigurationDocumentation|view the configuration documentation]] below the edit area.
apihelp-wbfacetsearch-summary: Get the facets configured for the item type of a search expression, with the value counts for that search.
apihelp-wbfacetsearch-extended-descripti: List facets return at most the 100 most frequent values. Range facets have no values.
apihelp-wbfacetsearch-param-search: Search expression to get the facets for. Must contain an item type filter, such as <kbd>haswbfacet:P1=Q1</kbd>.
apihelp-wbfacetsearch-param-namespaces: Namespaces to search. Defaults to all searchable namespaces, unlike <kbd>list=search</kbd>, which defaults to the main namespace.
apihelp-wbfacetsearch-example-1: Get the facets for items of type <kbd>Q1</kbd>.
apierror-wbfs-not-configured: Faceted search is not configured on this wiki.
apierror-wbfs-item-type-required: The search expression must contain an item type filter, such as <kbd>haswbfacet:P1=Q1</kbd>.
apierror-wbfs-invalid-search: The search expression contains a facet filter with an invalid property ID.
